# Hey Roseanne

> > A solo travel blog focused on Asia destinations, featuring detailed travel guides, itineraries, and vegan-friendly recommendations by Roseanne.

Hey Roseanne is a comprehensive travel resource specializing in Asian destinations with an emphasis on solo travel experiences, cultural landmarks, and practical accommodation and transportation advice. The blog covers popular Korean destinations like Busan and Seoul, alongside broader Asia travel content.

- Asia Travel
- Busan Travel Guides
- Korea Tourism

- Beach Destinations
- Haeundae Beach
- Gwangalli Beach
- Gamcheon Culture Village

- Accommodation Recommendations
- Travel Passes
- Day Trips
- Seoul
